review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review, not whole AnnexF certification.
parent_qualification: The test-only hint bit decoder is separate from the writer, but Read::of shares production Document, linearize::state and Parameters. It is not an entirely independent parser. The planted offset fault establishes one meaningful sensitivity check. TableF.2 L absence alone is not shown invalid; do not infer unconditional requiredness from a missing parenthetical.

reviewer_record.title: Linearized PDF is optional; incorrect or updated files remain readable through ordinary xref chain
reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:1137; 19887-19908. F.1 explicitly says unsupported processors can still successfully process linearized files less efficiently; length mismatch means ordinary PDF. §7.5.6 incremental update invalidates linearization.
reviewer_record.errata: Effective source is ISO 32000-2:2020 consolidated with EC3 (2026). F.3.1 contains the 2020 note permitting alternative part orderings; no Annex F-specific EC3 issue altering these rules was found in the consolidated source.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: The incremental-update regression opens updated bytes, verifies pages and NoLongerLinearized; source/read ordinary chain control. Fallback is mandatory even for non-Annex-F-supporting reader.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for sampled length-mismatch update and normal linearized read.
reviewer_record.residuals: This does not certify HTTP range/request performance; Annex G strategies are not asserted. The app explicitly declines Annex F fast-reader strategy under ADR 1225 / ledger 6.3.2.1 while serializer behind optimize --linearize is a producer.

reviewer_record.title: Catalog/document objects location; primary hint stream required, overflow optional; positions in decoded concatenated data; direct dictionary entries except Length; table keys conditional on features
reviewer_record.source_location: Processed EC3 md:20031-20087. Parts 4 and 5 may swap order; part 10 optional. Table F.2 requires S always and conditional entries for T/O/A/E/V/I/C/R/B; L exists for PDF 1.3.
reviewer_record.errata: Effective source is ISO 32000-2:2020 consolidated with EC3 (2026). F.3.1 contains the 2020 note permitting alternative part orderings; no Annex F-specific EC3 issue altering these rules was found in the consolidated source.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Feature-rich producer fixture checks Table F.2 entries and representative object positions; parameter test verifies /H, hint stream end and final object-number assignment.
reviewer_record.verdict: SUPPORTED for one feature-rich producer fixture and current writer.
reviewer_record.residuals: No overflow hint stream is emitted, so consumer/writer support for two-stream concatenation is not demonstrated by these writer tests; ADR 1293 claims overflow optional and omitted. EC3 part-order note means no failure if order differs among permitted parts.

reviewer_record.feature: Changed since 4015a9ae: generation-aware cache and linearization parameter lookup
reviewer_record.title: Current parser cache stores (generation,Object); state() now fetches the first xref-defined generation via defined_id instead of assuming generation 0
reviewer_record.source_location: Current code: crates/pdf-syntax/src/document.rs:127-132; 270-329; linearize.rs:287-312. Git diff 4015a9ae..b901326c shows cache key/value change and `state` uses document.defined_id(number). F.3.1 requires all objects in valid linearized file have generation 0.
reviewer_record.errata: Effective source is ISO 32000-2:2020 consolidated with EC3 (2026). F.3.1 contains the 2020 note permitting alternative part orderings; no Annex F-specific EC3 issue altering these rules was found in the consolidated source.
reviewer_record.test_assertions: Cold/warm tests confirm no stale cached generation alias; linearization writer checks generation-0 objects as part of xref-based round trip. `state` uses xref-defined generation to locate the file’s first object.
reviewer_record.verdict: PARTIAL for changed behavior; no Annex F defect found.
reviewer_record.residuals: Valid Annex F objects must gen 0, so a nonzero-generation linearization-parameter dictionary is invalid producer input and cannot serve as a mandatory-reader error test. `state()` is a detector, not full Annex F validator. Existing tests for valid writer behavior have gen 0.
